title: NCT07118891: Phase 1/2 study of ABCL635 for vasomotor symptoms
publisher: ClinicalTrials.gov, U.S. National Library of Medicine
excerpt: NCT07118891 is an active, not recruiting, randomized Phase 1/2 study with estimated enrollment of 136 and efficacy outcomes for moderate-to-severe vasomotor symptoms.
summary: The regulator registry verifies sponsor, trial identity, phase, status, design, enrollment, efficacy measures, and the June 2026 record update.
